content: Axřaq n Musa d tarewřa nnes
Uca iffeɣ ijj n weryaz zi raǧ n taddart n Lawi, yiwi ict n tḥenjirt n Lawi d tamɣart.
Teksi temɣart s ddeyset uca turuw-dd aḥenjir. Umi teẓra belli iṣbeḥ uḥenjir, teffar i-t třata n iyuren.
Umi war tezmar ɛad ad t teffar, teksi as-dd ict n tsenduqt n uɣanim, tebra i-tt s ucarmuḍ d tizeft uca tessars dayes aḥenjir, tegga tasenduqt nni jar uɣanim x tma n iɣzar.
Tbedd wučmas ɣar řaggʷaj, maḥend ad tẓar min zzayes ɣa ggen.

U xzar, tehwa yeǧis n firɛun, maḥend ad tessird ixef nnes deg iɣzar. Tuɣa timsexxarin tibřiɣin nnes ggurent x tma n iɣzar. Nettat teẓra tasenduqt deg uɣanim uca tessekk tismeɣt nnes uca teksi tt-i-dd.
Ařami tt tarzem, teẓra aḥenjir nni, uca xzar, aḥenjir tuɣa ittru. Yudef i-tt uziǧez, tenna: “Wa d ijj zeg iḥenjiren n Iɛibraniyyen!”
Řexdenni tenna učmas i yeǧis n firɛun: “Ma ad raḥeɣ ad řaɣiɣ x ict n temsuḍeḍt zi Tɛibraniyyin maḥend ad am tessuṭṭeḍ aḥenjir?”
Tenna as yeǧis n firɛun: “Ruḥ!” Truḥ teɛzarect, třaɣa i yemmas n uḥenjir.
Řexdenni tenna as yeǧis n firɛun: “Awi-dd aḥenjir-a, tessuṭṭeḍ i-t i necc u necc ad cem xeǧṣeɣ.” Teksi temɣart aḥenjir uca tessuṭṭeḍ i-t.
Umi igma uḥenjir, tiwyi i-t ɣar yeǧis n firɛun, idweř as am mmis uca tegga as Musa, tenna: “Aqa jebdeɣ t-i-dd zeg waman.”
Deg wussan nni imsar, umi igma Musa, aqa iffeɣ-dd ɣar aytmas, uca iẓra ddquřat i xasen ssarebbun. Iẓra ijj n Umiṣri iccat ijj n Uɛibrani, ijjen zeg aytmas.
Ixzar da d diha, iẓra belli war din ḥed, xenni inɣa Amiṣri nni uca issnuffar i-t deg ijdi.
Umi dd-iffeɣ tiwecca nnes, iẓra tnayen n yeryazen Iɛibraniyyen ttmenɣan. Inna Musa i uɛeffan nni ittɛeddan: “Maɣar teccated jjar nnec?”
Inna netta: “Wi i cek iggin d řḥakem d řqaḍi xaneɣ? Ma cek teqqared aya umi cek tenwid ad ayi tenɣed am mammec tenɣid Amiṣri?” Řexdenni iggʷed Musa, inna: “S tidett tamesřact tᵉttwassen!”
Umi isřa firɛun man aya, yarzu ad ineɣ Musa. Maca Musa yarweř zi firɛun uca izdeɣ di temmurt n Midyan uca iqqim din ɣar ijj n wanu.
Akehhan n Midyan tuɣa ɣares sebɛa n yessis, tinni i dd-yusin ad ayment aman din uca ccurent sswarej, ḥima ad wardent uǧi n babatsent.
Usin-dd imeksawen uca uẓẓřen xasent. Ikkar Musa řexdenni, ifekk i-tent, iward uǧi nsent.
Umi dewřent ɣar babatsent umi qqaren Raɛuyil, inna asent: “Mayemmi dd-ttɛeqbent ass-a deɣya?”
Nitenti arrint-i-dd xas: “Ijj n weryaz d Amiṣri ifekk aneɣ zeg ifassen n imeksawen uca ɛawed yuyem aneɣ-dd aṭṭas n waman uca iward uǧi.”
Inna i yessis: “I mani yeǧa? Mayemmi tejjint aryaz nni din? Ruḥent řaɣant-i-dd xas ḥima ad icc aɣrum!”
Uca iqbeř Musa ad izdeɣ ak-d weryaz nni uca netta iwca as i Musa yeǧis Ṣaffura d tamɣart.
Tejja as-dd aḥenjir, igga as Jarcum, minzi inna: “Necc tuɣa ayi d aɣrib deg ict n temmurt d taɣribt xafi.”
Řami teɛdu waṭṭas n řweqt, immut ujeǧid n Miṣra uca weḥweḥen ayt n Israil di tesmuɣi i di tuɣa ddaren, ssɣuyen uca iɣuyyan nsen geɛɛden ɣar AREBBI zi tesmuɣi nsen.
Uca issḥess AREBBI i tɣuyyit nsen uca ixarreṣ AREBBI di Řɛahd nnes ak-d Ibrahim u ak-d Isḥaq u ak-d Yaɛqub.
Ixzar AREBBI ɣar ayt n Israil uca yargeb AREBBI x řeɣben nsen.

footnotes.text: Raɛuyil- ɣares uřa d isem nneɣni, aqa-t Yitru. Xzar Ufuɣ 3:1. Isem-a ixs ad yini ‘ameddukkař n Arebbi’.
Jarcum- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘ijj n ubarrani (ǧiɣ) danita’.
